name: ArtCamp ArtCamp
operator_name: Anna Thompson and Sam Mrozowski, with WaterFire Providence
description_short: A one week art camp at the WaterFire Arts Center where children rotate through four daily art workshops led by two Providence elementary art teachers, drawing, painting and building in age groups.
refund_policy_summary: Full payment at registration and no refunds, including for missed days. A camper dismissed for behavior gets 50% of unused tuition back.
notes: Main camp is for rising grades 1 to 5; Week 2 adds a 10 spot studio pilot for rising grades 6 to 8. 9 am to 3 pm. Bring a lunch; no swimming or trips. 10 to 1 camper to staff ratio.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp page: rising grades 1 to 5, plus a 10 spot pilot for rising grades 6 to 8 in Week 2; Week 1 Monday August 10 to Friday August 14, Week 2 August 17 to 21; 9 am to 3 pm; $450 per week; two scholarship spots per session; bring lunch. Ages derived from grades 1 to 8. The page gives no year for the weeks: 2026 comes from its registration link (ArtCamp ArtCamp 2026) and August 10 falling on a Monday in 2026

source.title: ArtCamp ArtCamp at the WaterFire Arts Center - WaterFire Providence

for_andrew: The camp page lists the weeks without a year. I set 2026 from its linked registration page (titled ArtCamp ArtCamp 2026) and the weekdays. Accept that, or treat it as no current season?
The Humanitix registration page shows the event as Aug 10 to Aug 28, 2026 (three weeks), but the camp page lists only two weeks. I used the camp page.
grade_max is 8 only because of the small Week 2 pilot for grades 6 to 8; the main camp is rising grades 1 to 5.
